$comment: Single source of truth for the Drawer API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that rises from the bottom of the screen. Drag it down, press Esc or tap outside to close it.
thumb: Daily goal

open / defaultOpen.description: Use onOpenChange to hear about changes.

dismissible.description: Close on a tap outside and on a drag down.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A short form. Drag the handle or the title down to close it; on wide screens it stays a comfortable width. In HTML, add data-vin-drawer for dragging (vinui.js).

examples.title: Actions
examples.description: A list of actions, like a phone's share sheet.

a11y: It is the browser's modal <dialog>: focus is trapped inside, Esc closes it and focus returns to the button that opened it.
Dragging is a shortcut, never the only way: Esc, a tap outside and the close button all work too.
The handle is drawn with CSS, so screen readers don't announce an unlabelled control.
With reduced motion, it fades instead of sliding.
